 Scattered rainfall activity likely over TN 
 November 3, 2026 
 Keaweather 
 Some showers can be expected in TN over the next few days. Bay hosted 2 cyclones in 2 weeks both of which went to Andhra. Forecast for November looks positive for Chennai.
